Headonists

Headonists is a UK-based community of XR professionals gathering for informal talks, WIP showcases, drinks and chats.
​​The Headonists group connects professionals in the immersive space: creators, developers, producers, designers, students, academics, marketers, entrepreneurs etc.

I have been running quarterly events in COLAB Tower in Southwark for two years between 2025 and 2026.
